title: Loop mixing and duplicating received items
body:
### Bug Description

When a loop receives a table, it shuffles items from different rows.

When a dataframe is passed to the loop, each row is expected to be executed separately, but that's not happening.

### Reproduction

1. Create a flow with a loop.
2. Create more than one branch after the loop.
3. Add a dataframe with more than one column.
4. Run the flow and see items from different lines being shuffled.

### Expected behavior

The rows of a dataframe must be executed in isolation and uniquely within the loop.
